title: K-Silverfox Structure Pack Solo #10 (한국 · 굵은 스트라이프·매끈 · 체형 amazon bombshell)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Korean silver fox goddess luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin elegant silver-era maturity, late 40s, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, silver-white vintage victory rolls framing the face — her body carries 2 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 thick vertical stripes by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 22% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 51% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 72% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The stripes alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi waterfall climb formations in DEEP CRIMSON and SILVER, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Face: a real photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration and not a CG render — visible pores and fine skin grain, the fine natural expression lines of her age around the eyes and mouth, faint peach-fuzz hairs catching the light, natural tonal variation with a soft flush on the cheeks, a few small natural beauty marks, slight natural asymmetry, eyes with real wet catchlights and individual lashes, lips with real vertical texture — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
